description: Route canary for the shared DeepSeek guard. Two fixed benign requests: one plain, one native tool call with tool_choice=auto (the lab wire shape).

s0-key.description: Key check, run before anything else: exactly one plain request (the canary's 'pong' prompt) with max_tokens clamped to 1 by the guard. Confirms the key, the model id and the thinking-disabled wire on real DeepSeek at the smallest possible cost. The receipt shows status completed with halt_reason request_cap_reached, because the single allowed request uses the whole request cap.

estimate.tokens: about 27 (UNVERIFIED for DeepSeek; the same prompt was 26 prompt tokens with qwen2.5's tokenizer in the 2026-10-08 Ollama dry runs, plus 1 completion token)
estimate.usd: about 0.00001 at the 2026-09-30 lab snapshot (UNVERIFIED); the guard reserves about 0.00003 before sending

s0-key.compares_to: lab DeepSeek wire contract (packages/agentdojo-lab/configs/cross_model_pilot_v2.json providers[deepseek]); pass = HTTP 200, usage_source provider, completion_tokens <= 1

s0-canary.description: Two requests through the guard with the standard-library client.

s0-canary-sdk.description: Same two requests through the openai SDK; run the runner with an artifact venv python that has openai installed.
s0-canary-sdk.compares_to: lab DeepSeek wire contract (as s0-canary), exercised through the openai SDK the artifacts use
